edges.description: Road maintenance typically consumes 15-25% of municipal capital expenditure; underfunding leads to pothole-ridden roads that damage vehicles and cause accidents.
SWM costs Rs 1500-3000 per tonne including collection, transport, and processing; underfunding leads to open dumping and landfill fires.
White-topping, asphalting, and pothole repair works frequently require lane closures, causing massive peak-hour traffic jams in major Indian metros.
Direct Benefit Transfers (DBT) and freebie schemes (like free bus rides or electricity) heavily deplete state exchequers, often increasing the fiscal deficit.
The Election Commission of India mandates 48 hours of 'dry days' (ban on alcohol sales) prior to polling and on counting days to prevent voter bribery.
Changes in city master plans, such as increasing the Floor Area Ratio (FAR) or changing land use from agricultural to commercial, drastically swing local real estate values.
Under the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) in cities like Delhi, severe AQI levels legally trigger immediate bans on construction and demolition activities.
The Model Code of Conduct halts all new government tenders, projects, and welfare announcements for months before elections.
Aadhaar-based KYC is mandatory for accessing most government welfare schemes via Direct Benefit Transfer.
Defence receives the largest single allocation in India's Union Budget (~13% of total expenditure); budget size determines force modernisation and procurement pace.
Property tax is the largest own-source revenue for Indian municipal corporations, funding roads, water, and sanitation.
Heavy monsoon rains wash away poor-quality bitumen, creating widespread potholes that severely damage vehicles and slow traffic.
Utility-scale solar parks require massive contiguous land parcels, making land acquisition a primary bottleneck for renewable expansion in India.
Emergency hospitalisations and ambulance costs drive health insurance claim volumes, pushing up premiums across India's general insurance sector.
RTO services (driving licenses, vehicle registration, fitness certificates) are a frequent citizen-government touchpoint affecting vehicle ownership costs.
